text:
emily: Hi team — quick help. User (acct: acct_0x9f1) signed up from NL IP, verified email immediately, added PayPal and completed payment flow, but welcome free-trial credit didn't appear. Payment shows succeeded and email_verified=true. Anyone seen auto-grant fail for PayPal cross-border? logging below.

sam_support: thanks @emily — can you paste user email and the payment method id? also which region on account? :thinking:

emily: email: j.muller+redwood@example.com, pm: paypal_pm_7721, billing_country: NL, ip_country: NL, signup_ts: 2112233401. No 3DS involved. No fraud hold on account in admin console. :confused:

payments: looking — quick check in payments logs: `payment_method=paypal_pm_7721 status=completed gateway=paypal region=EU`

fraud_ops: echoing — our risk service flagged `suspicious_instrument` because PayPal email matched another account (j.muller@example.com) that had used a promo previously. System set manual_review=true which blocks autogrant. We show match_score=0.87.

emily: ah — duplicate alias. user did use plus-addressing. Is auto-grant supposed to dedupe on email alias? should it have allowed this since plus alias counts as same owner.

anya_engineer: auto-grant uses normalized email (lowercase, strip dots for gmail, but we don't strip plus-tags). That's an oversight. Repro steps: create acct with j.muller@example.com, then create + alias — system treats as distinct so risk detects duplicate later. Fix would be to normalize plus-tags for common providers or change dupe logic to compare base local part.

sam_support: for now can we manual grant? what are cs steps?

payments: yes — admin -> users -> acct_0x9f1 -> actions -> Grant welcome credit (reason: duplicate-plus-alias false positive). Also clear manual_review flag. Doing it now.

support-bot: ACTION LOG: payments granted 50 free trial credits to acct_0x9f1 — tx=grant_55021 by payments at 2112233720

emily: confirmed user sees credits. closing the ticket. Filed a GH issue for email normalization. @anya_engineer can you take the fix? :raised_hands:

anya_engineer: filing PR today with unit tests against common mailbox providers. Will also add a temporary rule to whitelist plus-tag matches for manual_review evaluation.

sam_support: thanks everyone — leaving notes on the support thread and tagging the customer. :white_check_mark:
